title: dithyrocarpus paniculatus
intro: Dithyrocarpus paniculatus, commonly known as Mahua or Butter Tree, is a deciduous tree native to the tropical forests of Asia. The health benefits of Dithyrocarpus paniculatus include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dithyrocarpus paniculatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
